findings.summary: A Heatmap (density) mark is gated behind Tableau's ``Heatmap`` document-format manifest entry. configure_chart(mark_type='Heatmap') writes the mark class but not the flag, so Tableau Desktop refuses the workbook with error d2e8da72 even though the XML is schema-valid.
findings.workaround: Call editor._ensure_manifest_entry('Heatmap') before configure_chart; the author's workbook carries the same manifest entry. A generic fix would map the mark class to its manifest flag in the builder's _reconcile_manifest_flags.

findings.summary: The author's datasource relates water_pumps, deaths_aggregate and deaths_individual with 1=1 relationship calculations. A multi-table Hyper relationship datasource returns Cloud error 403132 and renders blank.
findings.workaround: Materialise one flat (pump x individual death) Extract table in the builder, carrying the aggregated location's LocID/Deaths alongside; DISTANCE is defined per pair so the flat grain is equivalent.

findings.summary: Tableau's DISTANCE(...,'m') matches the WGS84 Vincenty inverse formula; the spherical law of cosines is one metre low on five of the eight pumps and disagrees with the author's published labels.
findings.workaround: The verifier implements the Vincenty inverse and asserts the exact integer labels from the article's screenshot.
